- IT Support Ticket Records [REC-042; Record Storage Requirement]
  All IT support ticket records are stored electronically in Saudia Academy's Freshdesk cloud-based account
  System or asset: Freshdesk | Evidence or record: IT Support Ticket Records | Storage location: Saudia Academy Freshdesk Account

- Meeting Minutes Records [REC-043; Record Storage Requirement]

  System or asset: PSAA Share File | Evidence or record: CBT Routine Card Records | Storage location: PSAA Share File

  System or asset: Freshdesk / PSAA Share File | Frequency or timing: Automatic | Evidence or record: Automatic Backup Record

- Retention of IT Records [REC-046; Retention Requirement]
  All IT records are retained permanently
  System or asset: All IT Records | Retention period: Permanent

  All IT staff and management can access and retrieve all IT records at any time
  Responsible role: All IT Staff and Management | System or asset: All IT Records | Frequency or timing: Any time

- Disposal of IT Records [REC-048; Disposal Requirement]
  No IT records will be disposed
  System or asset: All IT Records | Retention period: No disposal

  The EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card is retained permanently
  Evidence or record: EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card | Storage location: PSAA Share File/Information Technology/Forms | Retention period: Permanent

- Meeting Minutes [REC-050; Record Keeping]
  Meeting Minutes are retained permanently
  Evidence or record: Meeting Minutes | Storage location: PSAA Share File/Information Technology/IT Records/IT Meetings Records | Retention period: Permanent

- KPI Records [REC-051; Record Keeping]
  KPI records are retained permanently
  System or asset: Freshdesk | Evidence or record: KPI Records | Storage location: Saudia Academy Account in Freshdesk | Retention period: Permanent

  A KPI is a metric or measure used to quantify and evaluate organizational and achievement success

  KPIs are used to set measurable objectives evaluate progress monitor trends make improvements and support decision making

- Management Alert [REC-066; KPI Requirement]
  A KPI measurement shall alert management if there are impending problems in a Key Performance Area
  Responsible role: Management | Trigger or condition: Impending problems in a Key Performance Area

  The indicator consists of specific measurement data

  The indicator consists of a predetermined standard against which the data will be compared

  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Freshdesk Support Tickets | Frequency or timing: Measured from ticket creation | Target or threshold: Within 2 working days | Evidence or record: KPI Records / Support Ticket Timestamps

  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: IT Tickets | Frequency or timing: Per year | Target or threshold: Minimum 97 percent | Evidence or record: KPI Records

- Freshdesk Subscription [REC-079; System Description]
  Saudia Academy subscribes to the Freshdesk cloud-based support ticketing system
  System or asset: Freshdesk

- Freshdesk Purpose [REC-080; System Purpose]
  Freshdesk is used to receive follow and manage all IT defect ticket records
  System or asset: Freshdesk | Evidence or record: IT Defect Ticket Records

- Freshdesk Account Administrator [REC-081; System Role Assignment]
  The Manager IT is the Freshdesk Account Administrator
  Responsible role: Manager IT | System or asset: Freshdesk

- Freshdesk Agents [REC-082; System Role Assignment]
  All other IT team members are assigned as Freshdesk Agents
  Responsible role: All Other IT Team Members | System or asset: Freshdesk

- Freshdesk Account Link [REC-083; System Access Reference]
  Access to Saudia Academy's Freshdesk account is through the stated URL
  System or asset: Freshdesk | Reference or recipient: https://princesultanaviationacademysaudiairlines.freshdesk.com/

- Continuously Check New Tickets [REC-084; Ticket Monitoring Requirement]
  All IT Specialists are requested to continuously check Freshdesk for newly opened tickets
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Freshdesk | Frequency or timing: Continuously | Evidence or record: Support Ticket

- Follow and Close Old Tickets [REC-085; Ticket Follow-up Requirement]
  All IT Specialists are requested to follow and close old tickets
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Freshdesk | Frequency or timing: Continuously | Evidence or record: Support Ticket

- Open Ticket by Email [REC-086; Ticket Creation Method]
  A beneficiary can open a support ticket by sending an email to itsupport@psaa.com.sa
  Responsible role: Beneficiary Staff or Trainee | System or asset: Freshdesk | Trigger or condition: Support request | Evidence or record: Support Ticket | Reference or recipient: itsupport@psaa.com.sa

- Automatic Ticket Creation and Reply [REC-087; System Automation]
  Freshdesk automatically opens a ticket and replies to the requester with the ticket number
  System or asset: Freshdesk | Trigger or condition: Email sent to itsupport@psaa.com.sa | Evidence or record: Ticket Number Email

- Document Verbal Requests [REC-088; Ticket Documentation Requirement]
  The IT Specialist is responsible for opening tickets for support requests received verbally
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Freshdesk | Trigger or condition: Verbal support request | Evidence or record: Support Ticket

- Document Classroom and Lab Calls [REC-089; Ticket Documentation Requirement]
  The IT Specialist is responsible for opening tickets for calls received from running classrooms and labs
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Freshdesk | Trigger or condition: Call from a running classroom or lab | Evidence or record: Support Ticket

- Document Walk-in Requests [REC-090; Ticket Documentation Requirement]
  The IT Specialist is responsible for opening tickets for walk-in support requests
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Freshdesk | Trigger or condition: Walk-in support request | Evidence or record: Support Ticket

- Document Routine Check Defects [REC-091; Ticket Documentation Requirement]
  The IT Specialist is responsible for opening tickets for defects found during routine checks
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Freshdesk | Trigger or condition: Defect found during a routine check | Evidence or record: Support Ticket

## Records

1. Stations Powered On [REC-143; Daily Check]
  Make sure all stations are on
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: CBT Stations | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card F02 | Storage location: CBT Labs Second Floor

2. Peripheral Connection and Condition [REC-144; Daily Check]
  Make sure the headset mouse and keyboard are connected and nothing is broken
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Headset Mouse and Keyboard | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card F02 | Storage location: CBT Labs Second Floor

3. EDRAK Software Running [REC-145; Daily Check]
  Make sure EDRAK software is running on all stations
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: EDRAK Software | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card F02 | Storage location: CBT Labs Second Floor

4. Server Error Messages [REC-146; Daily Check]
  Check whether there are error messages on the EDRAK servers
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: EDRAK Servers | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card F02 | Storage location: Communication Room First Floor

5. Server and Switch Indicators [REC-147; Daily Check]
  Confirm that all indicator lights on all switches and servers are green and that there are no red lights
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Servers and Switches | Frequency or timing: Daily | Target or threshold: All green and no red light | Evidence or record: EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card F02 | Storage location: Communication Room First Floor

6. Server Cabinet Fans [REC-148; Daily Check]
  Make sure all server cabinet fans are operating properly and are clean
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Server Cabinet Fans | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card F02 | Storage location: Communication Room First Floor

7. Room Temperature and Airflow [REC-149; Daily Check]
  Make sure the room temperature is between 18 and 24 degrees Celsius and that air-conditioning flow is acceptable
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Communication Room | Frequency or timing: Daily | Target or threshold: 18-24 degrees Celsius | Evidence or record: EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card F02 | Storage location: Communication Room First Floor

8. Room Cleanliness and Cable Security [REC-150; Daily Check]
  Make sure the Communication Room is clean free of dust and debris tidy and that all wires are secured
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Communication Room | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Routine Maintenance Card F02 | Storage location: Communication Room First Floor

9. EDRAK Data Backup [REC-151; Daily Check]
  Conduct an EDRAK data backup
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: EDRAK | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Backup Files | Storage location: Communication Room First Floor

9.1. Log in to SQL Virtual Machine [REC-152; Backup Step]
  Log in to the SQL virtual machine from the H1 server
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: H1 Server / SQL Virtual Machine | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Backup Files | Storage location: Communication Room First Floor | Parent record: REC-151

9.2. Open Backup Scripts [REC-153; Backup Step]
  Open the two backup scripts in C drive using MSSQL
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: MSSQL Backup Scripts | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Backup Files | Storage location: C Drive | Parent record: REC-151

9.3. Update Backup File Date [REC-154; Backup Step]
  Change the file name in the script to today's date
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: Backup Script | Frequency or timing: Daily | Target or threshold: Current date | Evidence or record: EDRAK Backup Files | Parent record: REC-151

9.4. Run Backup Script [REC-155; Backup Step]
  Run the backup script
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: MSSQL Backup Script | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Backup Files | Parent record: REC-151

9.5. Copy to H3 SQL Virtual Machine [REC-156; Backup Step]
  Copy the backup files to the H3 SQL virtual machine
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: H3 SQL Virtual Machine | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Backup Files | Storage location: H3 SQL Virtual Machine | Parent record: REC-151

9.6. Copy to External Hard Drive [REC-157; Backup Step]
  Copy the backup files to the external hard drive
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | System or asset: External Hard Drive | Frequency or timing: Daily | Evidence or record: EDRAK Backup Files | Storage location: External Hard Drive | Parent record: REC-151

- Interrupted or Incomplete Routine Task [REC-158; Exception Documentation Requirement]
  When a routine task is interrupted or cannot be completed within its timeframe an appropriate comment shall be written in the remark field of the routine maintenance card
  Responsible role: IT Specialist | Trigger or condition: Routine task interrupted or not completed within its timeframe | Evidence or record: Remark Field on CBT Routine Maintenance Card
